title: Polynomial work bound for exact sparse learning
statement: For every Boolean target function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and every natural number $k$, the local work charged when the exact sparse-spectrum learner is run against the target is at most $1+2^{171}\bigl(12(n+1)(2^k+1)^2\bigr)^{100}$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean target function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
